note: Daily council 2026-08-08. PRE-REGISTRATION, committed before any result exists. Selection and collision checks were run at 2026-08-08T11:15Z, at session open, BEFORE this file was written or committed (0807-O7 ruling: a pasted repository fact must be labelled with when it was run, because it is not reproducible at its own commit): `sorted(glob('*.json'))[-1]` over analytics/fetch-requests/ returned 2026-08-07-daily.json, and with this filename appended returns 2026-08-08-daily.json, so this batch is the one newest_request() will select despite the lexicographic-not-mtime defect (2026-08-05, propose-only, still unfixed at session open); and `ls analytics/fetch-results/ | grep -c 2026-08-08` returned 0, so there is no name collision. SEVEN ROWS IN TWO GROUPS, both structured to the amended decision rule adopted from 2026-08-07 memo section 2.7 as amended by ruling 0807-B4 (the word 'exhaustively' struck; no_client added to the uninformative row), with the P0 same-host positive-control precondition as a HARD GATE evaluated before any substantive branch. PRE-FLIGHT CHECK RUN, per the house rule adopted at 2026-08-07 section 2.6-D1: every (outcome, status-class) pair below maps to a named branch, and the uninformative branch is named explicitly rather than left to be read through a neighbouring clause. GROUP 1 - A/81/17, day 8 of the publication window, on a SECOND RETRIEVAL SURFACE. Yesterday's close-out ruled that a seventh sample point on the UNCITRAL Commission Sessions page buys nearly nothing: six sample points have returned one byte-identical representation (bytes 832338, sha256 ca87a113...1e21706), and day-to-day nulls on a byte-identical page are NOT additive. So the Commission Sessions page is NOT re-fired today. Instead this takes the UN Digital Library route (digitallibrary.un.org) proposed by the integrity officer on 2026-08-02 at analytics/optimization-log.md line 11 and never executed - a distinct third surface on separate infrastructure from both uncitral.un.org and docs.un.org. The retired undocs.org / docs.un.org symbol route is NOT revived: different host, different system. This is retrieval, not discovery, and the distinction matters because the relay is not a discovery channel (fetch-requests/README.md, METHODOLOGY Part VIII): the symbol A/81/17 was identified by the record weeks ago and is the subject of standing open thread 3; this batch retrieves an already-identified symbol on a new surface, and requests no unknown item. THE ECHO HAZARD, pre-registered because it would otherwise manufacture a false positive: a search-result page typically renders the submitted query back into the page, so a find on the symbol could match the echoed query string rather than any record, and the relay's find is a case-insensitive substring test over stripped rendered text that cannot tell those apart. Row 3 is therefore a NEGATIVE control on a symbol that cannot exist - A/99/17 would be the 99th session's Commission report, roughly forty years out - and it is what separates echo from existence. GROUP 2 - THE COMPLETE 2x2, IN ONE BATCH, on the identification residual that is the last thing standing between ruling 0804-B7 and a clean close. Yesterday's attempt split the factorial across two days and the second cell returned a 500, which under the then-current rule fell in no branch at all and left the cell unrecoverable; the close-out ruled the whole 2x2 be re-fired in a single batch. The question: when investmentpolicy.unctad.org returns the head 'China - Switzerland BIT (2009)', is that head keyed to the numeric record id, to the URL slug, or to neither? Four cells cross a TRUE id (978) and a FALSE id (999999) against a TRUE slug (china---switzerland-bit-2009-) and a FALSE slug (zzz---zzz-bit-1900-). Row 4 is the TRUE/TRUE cell and DOUBLES AS THE P0 SAME-HOST POSITIVE CONTROL for this host. Every row in this group carries a non-empty find, correcting the 0807-B5 defect in which a row fired with find:'' and recorded find_matched:false having asked nothing - a three-state field (found / looked and did not find / asked nothing) read by a later seat as a null. DECISION RULES, FIXED IN ADVANCE. GROUP 1: (P0) if row 2 - the known-published A/80/17, this host's positive control - does not return outcome 'ok' with find_matched true, NO BRANCH IS ENTERED and the batch is recorded as uninformative about this host; the route is not thereby retired, it is simply untested. (E) ECHO TEST, evaluated second: if row 3 returns find_matched TRUE, the page echoes the query and this surface carries NO existence information at the relay's rendered-text reduction level; row 1 is then uninformative WHATEVER it says, and the route is retired for symbol-existence purposes with that reason recorded. (1a) If P0 holds and row 3 is find_matched FALSE, the surface discriminates, and row 1 find_matched FALSE means A/81/17 is absent from the rendered text of this surface's result at this timestamp - a genuinely SECOND surface, not another reading of the same page state. (1b) If P0 holds, row 3 is FALSE and row 1 is find_matched TRUE, that is a POSITIVE and a state change: it is NOT to be asserted as publication on this datum alone, but escalated, and confirmed by retrieving the record page itself in a later batch before any claim is made or any confidence cell moves. (1c) Any outcome other than 'ok' on any row - refused 5xx, refused 403 or 429, refused other non-200, no_contact, no_client, robots_disallowed, not_attempted, scheme_not_https, private_address, host_not_allowed - is UNINFORMATIVE for that row, no conclusion is drawn from it, and if it strikes row 2 or row 3 the group is uninformative entire. GROUP 2: (P0) if row 4 does not return outcome 'ok', HTTP 200, find_matched true, NO BRANCH IS ENTERED for this host and no discharge is claimed either way. (2a) If P0 holds and BOTH false-id rows (6, 7) return 404 or 410, or a final_url differing from the requested URL, WHILE row 5 (true id, false slug) returns 200 with find_matched true, then the numeric id is load-bearing and the slug is not: the head is keyed to the id, the 0804-B7 discharge SURVIVES and the identification residual CLOSES. (2b) If row 6 (FALSE id, TRUE slug) returns 200 with find_matched true, the head tracks the slug irrespective of the id, yesterday's discharge was reasoning from an ambiguous datum, and B7 REOPENS at URL-slug level. This is the branch that costs us something and it is named here before the result exists. (2c) If row 7 (FALSE id, FALSE slug) returns 200 with find_matched true, the head is keyed to NEITHER component, and the identification argument collapses entirely: this channel cannot identify a record at the reduction level, and B7 reopens further than 2b. (2d) PARTIAL 2x2: if ANY of the four cells returns a non-'ok' outcome or any status class not named in 2a-2c, the factorial is INCOMPLETE and NO closure and NO reopening is claimed on the strength of the surviving cells. A 2x2 missing a cell does not become a 1x2 that happens to agree with us. That is the exact failure of 2026-08-07 and it is pre-empted here rather than adjudicated afterwards. NOT FIRED TODAY: Huawei ARB/22/2 (ICSID), a STANDING WEEKLY row adopted 2026-08-06 with the next firing dated 2026-08-13; a schedule set by the council is not re-opened because rows are cheap.
